name: Brighouse Foodbank
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels to residents in need. Based at Brighouse Central Methodist Church. Open Tue and Thu 10am-2pm. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Brighouse Community Garden
short_description: Therapeutic community garden at Wellholme Park
description: Community garden run by volunteers offering raised beds and accessible growing spaces. Part of Wellholme Park with support from Brighouse Community Trust. Open during daylight hours.

name: Bailiff Bridge Community Garden
short_description: Volunteer-run community garden with wildlife area
description: Small community garden at Bailiff Bridge with vegetable plots and pollinator-friendly plants. Open weekends and Wed evenings. Contact via Facebook: @BailiffBridgeGarden.
